t_advice_summary_textbox.text: When one colour basket gives a high score, keep selecting it until the score starts to go down then swith the baskets. Basket colour is linked to the colour of the gnome hats.

vb_textbox.text: There are two groups of wizards based on colour. Purple, brown, red wizards belong to the red basket for collecting mushrooms. Yellow, green, pink and orange wizards belong to the yellow basket for collecting mushrooms. When you choose a basket and your score is 15 mushrooms or more, keep choosing wizards for that basket. When the score decreases a lot, choose the other basket colour.
